tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_articles
tools.description: List knowledge-base articles. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /article.json. Optionally filter by project_id (the knowledge base). Returns the list envelope { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_get_article
tools.description: Fetch a single article by id. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /article/{id}.json. Returns { valid, data:{...} }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_categories
tools.description: List categories (the article tree/table of contents). KnowledgeOwl API: GET /category.json. Optionally filter by project_id. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_get_category
tools.description: Fetch a single category by id. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /category/{id}.json.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_tags
tools.description: List article tags. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /tag.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_snippets
tools.description: List reusable content snippets. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /snippet.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_glossary_terms
tools.description: List glossary terms and definitions. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /glossaryterm.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_comments
tools.description: List reader comments / feedback on articles. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /comment.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_readers
tools.description: List readers (knowledge-base end users / audience accounts). KnowledgeOwl API: GET /reader.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_get_reader
tools.description: Fetch a single reader by id. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /reader/{id}.json.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_files
tools.description: List files in the file library (images/attachments). KnowledgeOwl API: GET /file.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_article_versions
tools.description: List article versions. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /articleversion.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_article_revisions
tools.description: List article revision history (read-only audit trail). KnowledgeOwl API: GET /articlerevision.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_suggestions
tools.description: List search suggestions / reader search analytics (what readers searched for). KnowledgeOwl API: GET /suggest.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_synonyms
tools.description: List search synonyms (terms treated as equivalent by search). KnowledgeOwl API: GET /synonym.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_webhooks
tools.description: List configured webhooks. KnowledgeOwl API: GET /webhook.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_list_authors
tools.description: List authors/agents (the team members who write and manage content). KnowledgeOwl API: GET /agent.json. Returns { valid, page_stats, data:[...] }.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any KnowledgeOwl API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the base, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/article.json?_page=2" or "/category/abc123.json". Returns the parsed JSON.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_create_article
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: creates a new article. KnowledgeOwl API: POST /article.json (JSON). Required by the API: project_id, name, status, url_hash, visibility, and current_version (a nested object `{ <lang>: { title, body, ... } }` — pass it via the `fields` passthrough). Returns the created art

tools.name: knowledgeowl_update_article
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: updates an existing article. KnowledgeOwl API: PUT /article/{id}.json (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for current_version (title/body) and any other documented field. The path id is never sent in the body.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_create_category
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: creates a new category (a node in the article tree). KnowledgeOwl API: POST /category.json (JSON). Required by the API: type, project_id, url_hash, name, visibility, status. Pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created category.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_update_category
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: updates an existing category. KnowledgeOwl API: PUT /category/{id}.json (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for any other documented field. The path id is never sent in the body.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_create_snippet
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: creates a reusable content snippet. KnowledgeOwl API: POST /snippet.json (JSON). Pass the snippet body/content and any other documented field via `fields` (e.g. snippet_text/body). Returns the created snippet.

tools.name: knowledgeowl_create_glossary_term
tools.description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: creates a glossary term and definition. KnowledgeOwl API: POST /glossaryterm.json (JSON). Pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created glossary term.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: knowledgeowl_list_comments · Private data: knowledgeowl_list_files · Public sink: knowledgeowl_list_webhooks, knowledgeowl_create_article, knowledgeowl_create_category, knowledgeowl_create_snippet, knowledgeowl_create_glossary_term.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: knowledgeowl_list_comments · Private data: knowledgeowl_list_files · Public sink: knowledgeowl_list_webhooks, knowledgeowl_create_article, knowledgeowl_create_category, knowledgeowl_create_snippet, knowledgeowl_create_glossary_term

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
